summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The npm package advertises itself as a Vue collapsible-group UI component but ships a preinstall script (setup.mjs) with hex-mangled identifiers that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime archive (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, unzips it, chmods it 0755, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (shuffled string/constant array, `_0xNNNN` mangled identifiers, rotating-array decoder) that is not referenced by the package's declared library entry and is not present in the published `files` list — it exists to be executed by the Bun interpreter fetched at install time. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern (a downloaded interpreter running an opaque bundled payload) bypasses Node-based inspection, and the payload's purpose has no relation to a UI collapsible-group component.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
